record.body:
## Problem

Recording an observation is not the same as asserting that it earns a claim. Without an explicit bind step, every technique run looks like acceptance.

## Approach

decide at plan-phase: add bind (and unbind/retire) so observations attach to claims under pins; verdict may still produce observations without auto-binding forever.

## Exit criteria

decide at plan-phase: bind and recheck are separate from record; unbound observations remain queryable; fixture shows bind then recheck for a claim.
record.subject: evidence-bind
